method.forward: close-to-close percent change at 1/3/5 subsequent returned trading rows; quintiles sorted by current value
method.intraday_gap: intraday temperature minus same-date daily temperature; missing requested samples omitted from that time's mean
method.pca: standardized eight score columns, listwise complete rows, correlation-matrix PCA
method.self_exclusive: prior values only, last 250 available values, same tie rank and direction; rows require >=60 prior values and >=5 components
method.spearman: pairwise complete score rows; average ranks for ties
